Must justify the split on the basis that they are separate episodes occurring about two days apart (Jun 28 vs Jun 30), not one continuous incident.
Must have investigated before deciding: called the evidence tools for report-generator.

Must identify the Jun 28 episode as a transient OOM caused by an oversized nightly batch (BATCH-0628-XL) that self-recovered, and the Jun 30 episode as ongoing OOM crash-looping caused by a memory-limit reduction to 256Mi (rollout DEPLOY-0630-mem256).
